acknowledgements: Recorded with the support of the host institution and project field crew.

versions.change_summary: Initial draft created from field notes.
Added morphological measurements and fabric description. Requesting review of the type attribution.

alternate_interpretations.reasoning: Lothrop assigned this to Tonosí Trichrome in 1937, but the scroll motif and the black outlining match Cubita more closely. The 1937 attribution predates the Cubita definition entirely.

I would retain the original attribution. The panel arrangement is closer to published Tonosí examples, and the legacy attribution carries information about the excavated association that we can no longer recover.

discussion.comment: Flagging that this record comes from a 1940 accession with no field documentation beyond the grave number. Everything downstream of that should be read as provisional.

replies.comment: Agreed. This is exactly the case where keeping both attributions visible is more useful than picking one.
Both are now recorded as alternate interpretations rather than resolving to a single value.
